purpose: observational device baseline for CELL525; no before/after performance claim

restore.interpretation: FD-map restore entered; no per-descriptor trace. Capture does not prove crash, deadlock, or a specific file failure.

performance.scene_classification: unknown; gameplay, menu, and cinematic are not separately labelled
performance.cpu_and_range_wait_scope: aggregated across threads per presented frame; not additive wall-clock stalls

gpu_allocations.scope: requested allocation bytes, not physical or resident GPU RAM
gpu_allocations.interpretation: Texture allocations grow while system and scratch pools stay stable. Active/stale/pending split missing; no reclaimable-byte proof. Post-stop VMA snapshot remains nonzero with zero pool counters.

neoswap.accounting: Footprint, resident, and compressed ledger overlap; do not sum. Virtual reservations, mapped aliases, configured capacities, donor backing and cumulative traffic are not additional physical RAM.

limitations: Unmatched scenes and settings; no controlled before/after or cold-cache comparison.
